## Diwali Playbook Overview

This playbook consolidates performance data and lessons learned from the Diwali festivals of 2024 and 2025. No records exist for Diwali at Spice Garden prior to 2024.

## Ingredient and Packaging Performance

| Item | 2024 Planned | 2024 Used | 2024 Outcome | 2025 Planned | 2025 Used | 2025 Outcome |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sugar (kg) | 25 | ~32+ | Stock-out (Nov 1) | 45 | 41 | No stock-out |
| Ghee (kg) | N/A | ~2.5x normal | Stock-out (Nov 1) | 12 | 15 | Stock-out (Oct 20) |
| Paneer (kg) | 26 | 18 | 8 kg wasted | 20% reduction | - | No waste |
| Kaju Katli (boxes) | 0 | 0 | 40 orders lost | - | 158 | Goal met |
| Sweet Boxes | N/A | N/A | Stock-out (Nov 1) | 200 | 186 | Goal met |

## Strategic Planning and Lessons Learned

- **Order Timing**: Order at least one week before Diwali. In 2024, ordering 4 days prior (Oct 25) led to a 2-day delivery delay from Balaji Traders. In 2025, ordering one week early (Oct 3) successfully mitigated delivery delays.
- **Supplier Reliability**: Balaji Traders is prone to delays during the pre-Diwali rush in Begum Bazar (2024, 2025). Always maintain Deccan Wholesale Mart as a backup supplier, as done in 2025.
- **Prices**: Balaji Traders increased cashew prices by 18% (₹980 to ₹1,160/kg) one week before Diwali 2025. Procuring from Deccan Wholesale Mart at ₹1,040/kg saved costs (2025).
- **Corporate Orders**: 120 boxes of kaju katli were sold for corporate gifts in 2025. Late confirmation in 2025 caused some companies to split their orders with other vendors.
- **Menu Additions**: Adding kaju katli boxes in 2025 drove a 62% year-on-year increase in dessert revenue.
- **Revenue Trends**: Revenue grew from ₹6.4L (2024) to ₹8.9L (2025), a 39% increase.
- **Mistakes to Avoid**: 
  - Never allow sugar levels to fall below a 2-day supply: 55 dessert orders were lost in 2024 due to a total sugar stock-out.
  - Do not overstock paneer: Demand for paneer mains decreased by 15% in 2024, resulting in 8 kg of waste.
  - Ensure sufficient Ghee supply: 2025 Ghee consumption (15 kg) exceeded stock (12 kg), forcing a pause in jalebi preparation.
